issue.title: Carry per-event attachment manifests in sase bead history instead of joining to the current roster

task_type_fields.proposal:
`sase bead history` should show each note event's own attachment manifest (name, mime_type, size, image dims, sha256) from the event payload.

Today sase-core `crates/sase_core/src/bead/history.rs` diffs flattened note text and drops `NoteAppended.attachments` and `NoteEdited.attachments`. So `src/sase/bead/cli_history.py::_attachment_descriptor_lines` joins `@attachment:<name>` tokens to the bead's *current* roster. Any attachment later detached by an edit, removed with its note, or renamed prints only `name (not on the current bead)`, with no mime or size.

Fix: have core history carry the per-event manifest on notes changes. `cli_history.py` already renders a wired `attachments` list when present, via `_wired_attachment_lines`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The note_cli plan of epic sase-1ck (child epic sase-1ck.4.1) said not to change sase-core history, and it explicitly permitted the current-roster fallback. It asked for a follow-up if historical mime and size were still missing, and sase-1ck.4.1.land recorded that gap on epic sase-1ck (note #1). This is a fidelity improvement to an intentionally bounded read surface, not a defect in the shipped behavior.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1ck note #1 (from the sase-1ck.4.1 lander) asked for an assessment of history fidelity for attachments, and no later phase addressed it. The sase-1ck lander is filing it as the planned follow-up.
